Trump presented himself as a world conqueror who would brook no dissent. Those days are over! WOW! @CarissaVeliz  delivered this year one the most astute, original and insightful TED talks I have heard in a very long time. I never saw technologists who are making bold PREDICTIONS as sinister actors who are exercising POWER over others — and the future. Listen to this talk. A star is born! As we reflect on the 10-year anniversary of the death of Prince, I want to share a happy moment. During the 2012 election season, Prince, Rosario Dawson and I went on the View to announce Rebuild The Dream and encourage people to use their voices for change. It was a thrilling moment— and it kicked off a powerful concert series and campaign. He never had never done anything like that before.

The Trump administration has a surplus of drama — but a deficit of attention to the things most Americans care about (like lower prices).

It's been more than 45 days since Iran's internet went dark. And the Iranian regime is burning through MILLIONS per day to keep 92 million people offline.

Why spend so much to silence your own country? Because when you control the internet, you control the story. When a government won't let its OWN PEOPLE speak, question the narrative the outside world is hearing.

War in Iran: Every Argument For It and Against It — Laid Bare open.substack.com/pub/vanjon…

When you woke up this morning, your internet worked. You scrolled, you searched, you shared. But 90 million Iranians woke up — again — to total darkness. Their government has now imposed the longest nationwide internet blackout ever recorded in any country. Almost 40 consecutive days.

That should alarm every one of us. Iran’s information blackout is a weapon against its own people. When governments can flip a switch and immediately disappear 90 million people from the internet, the rest of us l

This isn't how a Commander-in-Chief traditionally addresses the U.S. public during wartime.

Let's be clear about what we're facing: The Islamic Republic of Iran has killed many Americans over nearly four decades. It’s waging cyber war against us. It’s mastered gray-zone warfare and information operations.

The regime’s capabilities are real. Its intentions are murderous.

This is a serious enemy. This is a serious war. And it demands serious leadership.

Let’s break down Trump's disastrous Iran speech: Americans needed clarity on three things. Trump delivered ZERO.

(1) On the question of regime change, he played word games. So far, all we have done is replace an older Supreme Leader with a younger Supreme Leader. That’s not regime change.  
(2) On the question of Iran’s nuclear materials, rather than promising to get them out of the country, Trump says we'll just watch those nuclear sites from satellites. (We were ALREADY doing that. No need fo

Trump was at the U.S. Supreme Court today,  — doing the wrong thing, at the wrong time, in the wrong place, for the wrong reasons. No U.S. president should be in the front row of the US Supreme Court — mad dogging justices he appointed. And no U.S. president should be trying to deny citizenship to babies born in America in the first place. #SCOTUS

The internet wants you dumb and angry.
I wrote 5,000 words trying to do something different.
The strongest arguments for and against the SAVE America Act (Trump’s “VOTER I.D.” Bill)  — from serious people on BOTH sides.
Read it here: vanjones.substack.com/p/chea…

Two blind spots nobody is talking about:
Pro-bill advocates: The 83% who "support voter I.D." were asked about a STATE photo I.D. — not a birth certificate or passport. That's a bait-and-switch.
Anti-bill critics: Calling it Jim Crow 2.0 ignores that rural white conservative voters would also face barriers. Precision matters.
